INNER JOIN companies AS c ON r."CompanyId" = c.guid

    ORDER BY j."PostedDate" DESC
    LIMIT @__p_1 OFFSET @__p_0
) AS j0
INNER JOIN recruiters AS r ON j0."RecruiterID" = r.guid
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT p.guid, p."JobPostId", p."SkillId", s.guid AS guid0, s."Name"
    FROM "postSkills" AS p
    INNER JOIN skills AS s ON p."SkillId" = s.guid
) AS s0 ON j0.guid = s0."JobPostId"
LEFT JOIN locations AS l ON j0.guid = l."JobPostId"
LEFT JOIN responsibilities AS r0 ON j0.guid = r0."PostId"
LEFT JOIN requirements AS r1 ON j0.guid = r1."PostId"
ORDER BY j0."PostedDate" DESC, j0.guid, r.guid, s0.guid, s0.guid0, l.guid, r0.guid

    WHERE NOT (c."IsDeleted") AND c.guid = @__key_0
    LIMIT 1
) AS s
LEFT JOIN recruiters AS r ON s.guid = r."CompanyId"
LEFT JOIN address AS a ON s.guid = a."companyId"
ORDER BY s.guid, s.guid0, r.guid
